description: This file is a shell script that performs network connectivity testing and self-healing procedures for a device. It includes functions to reset the router, perform ping and DNS tests, and take corrective actions based on test results.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the corrective action from syscfg.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay before starting ping tests.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router device by invoking a simulation command.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Decides whether to reset the router based on process name and other conditions.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS resolution test and takes corrective actions if needed.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs network ping tests and triggers a reset if pings fail.
